title: PULCRA SUNT QUAE VISA PLACENT
html_source:
From Latin,
Those things are beautiful which please when they are seen

anchor.prefix:
the beautiful is is another question.

 He rubbed his hands slowly and drily over the difficulty.

 —Can you solve that question now? he asked.

 —Aquinas, answered Stephen, says
anchor.suffix:
.

 —This fire before us, said the dean, will be pleasing to the eye. Will it therefore be beautiful?

 —In so far as it is apprehended by the sight, which I suppose means here est
